description: Use this skill when the user wants to add SolvaPay checkout to a Lovable app (Vite + shadcn + Supabase Edge) on the preview/dev channel with secrets server-side — paste-in checkout, gate content behind purchase, or set up billing; even when they do not name SolvaPay; no-backend preview flow. Triggers on: lovable checkout, lovible checkout, vite shadcn checkout solvapay, paste into lovable, solvapay lovable supabase @preview, @preview solvapay react-supabase install, my supabase checkout solvapay preview tag, solvapay secret only supabase server side not client, boss wants solvapay checkout pasted into our lovable vite app, i need paywall on lovable app do this fast, set up billing in my vite supabase app from lovable, shadcn ui purchase gate, supabase edge billing. Do not use for production Next.js checkout (solvapay/website-checkout), full SDK metering in an existing backend (solvapay/sdk-integration), or building a paid MCP server (solvapay/create-mcp-app).
